info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: kutsitagatiH = palAyanam . nindA ca . svApe nipUrvakoyam . ' dE svapne drAyati drAti kutsite gamane luki ' (Slo. 6) iti devaH .

examples: 'pra vIrayA Sucayo dadrire vAm' (f॰7.90.1). pradadrire pradadruH pradrARA dInA aBUvannityarTaH.
'yatra suptvA punarnAvadrAsyanBavati' (Sa0 brA0 3.2.2.23). nAvadrAsyanBavati=nidrAlurna Bavati, nidrayA nABiBUyata ityarTaH.
'yadi nidrAyAt kAmaM svapyAt' (Sa0 brA0 3.9.3.11). yadi nidrAyAd yadi pramIlitaH syAt, yadi pracalAyitaH syAt.
'na taM tigmaM cana tyajo na drAsadaBi taM guru' (f0 8.47.7). aBidrAsat AsAdayati. drAteH paYcame lakAre tipi rUpam.
